sourceText:
Homemade Breakfast Pizza
By: Julia
Published: Wednesday, March 16, 2016 - 10:35am

Ingredients




4 Mushrooms
4-6 Frankfurters/Sausages
1 can Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce
2 Medium Tomatoes
4 Small – Medium Eggs
2 Medium Onions
6-8 Bacon strips
+ pizza dough (homemade or shop bought) or a pizza base
A little oil for frying

Preparation

1 Slice the mushrooms, onions, frankfurters (or sausages when using) and tomatoes. 2 Fry the onion with bacon for 2-3 minutes until the onion turns brown and the bacon is cooked. 3 Place the pizza dough on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Spread baked beans over, followed by the rest of the sliced ingredients. Finally, crack a small egg on top of it. 4 Bake in a preheated oven @ 220C for 12-15 minutes or until ready. If using shop-bought dough then follow packet instructions. 5 Enjoy!

About

Breakfast pizza with bacon, mushrooms, beans and eggs is the way to start your day! All your favorite things on a pizza crust! It’s hard to resist this deliciousness!
